tasks.title: Project Setup and Architecture

tasks.title: Core Portfolio Components and Data Layer
tasks.description: Implement typed data models for projects, skills, and experience, along with reusable UI components adhering to DRY and SOLID principles.

tasks.title: Interactive Features and Responsive Design
tasks.description: Build interactive sections including project filtering, contact form with validation, and ensure fully responsive, accessible design across devices.

tasks.title: Code Review and Quality Assurance
tasks.description: Perform rigorous code review, ensure TypeScript strict compliance, optimize bundle performance, and verify accessibility (a11y) standards.

tasks.title: Build Validation and Deployment Preparation
tasks.description: Run production build validation, test static asset generation, and configure deployment artifacts for production readiness.
